label: billing withhold
definition: Synthetic retention of a percentage of interim payments pending system correction.
boundary_rule: Do not confuse with synthetic liquidated damages or final price adjustments.

label: cost baseline
definition: Synthetic time-phased budget basis used to measure synthetic estimating variance.
boundary_rule: Excludes synthetic management reserve and unpriced change orders.

label: rate window
definition: Synthetic period allowed to complete a forward pricing rate check.
boundary_rule: Distinct from the synthetic billing cycle review interval.

label: system review
definition: Synthetic periodic assessment of business-system control operation.
boundary_rule: Does not include synthetic external financial statement audits.
